prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a gym bag dropping onto the floor by the kitchen door, keys sliding across the counter. The camera whips to a pan already screaming as chicken strips hit it, steam and sizzle erupting. Money shot: a loaded burrito bowl built in seconds — rice, black beans pouring, the golden chicken, avocado fanned with one hand motion, lime squeezed with droplets backlit. Final beat: the bowl on the counter, a clock glowing soft in the background bokeh, fork in. Warm night-kitchen light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the bag drop, then the sear. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
